feed.title: AI Wiki — Daily Signal
feed.subtitle: The day's most important AI model releases, lab announcements, and security news.

entry.title: Mathematical Proof Exposes Limits of Context-Based LLM Safeguards
entry.summary: Demonstrates that open-weights context safeguards cannot simultaneously guarantee utility, safety, and open access without external credential mechanisms.

entry.title: Schema-Formatted Tool Specs Introduce Safety Failures in AI Agents
entry.summary: Identifies structured tool schemas as a major driver of alignment degradation in agents and introduces SafeKeep to restore refusal behaviors.

entry.title: Audit of Commercial AI Products Exposes System Prompt Vulnerabilities
entry.summary: Evaluates system prompts across 88 commercial AI applications to quantify gaps between developer safety rules and actual model behavior.

entry.title: Advantage Fusion Framework Prevents Entropy Collapse in Post-Training RL
entry.summary: Resolves magnitude and temporal mismatches when combining verifiable reward RL with on-policy distillation for reasoning models.

entry.title: Credit Reallocation Method Enhances GRPO for Long CoT Reasoning
entry.summary: Reduces reinforcement learning credit for easily substituted tokens to improve policy gradients without changing the total reward budget.

entry.title: Adaptive Reasoning Framework Cuts CoT Tokens by Up to 60 Percent
entry.summary: Dynamically allocates reasoning steps according to input difficulty using reinforcement learning to significantly reduce inference compute.

entry.title: OpenAI uses internal Astra model to solve 10 unsolved math problems
entry.summary: Demonstrates automated reasoning progress by publishing verifiable Lean 4 formalizations for decade-old open problems in mathematics.

entry.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5, its new flagship model
entry.summary: Anthropic's new top-tier model is now available, continuing the rapid release cycle from major AI labs.

entry.title: OpenAI announces GPT-5.6, focusing on price-performance
entry.summary: A new model in the GPT-5 series is available, positioned as a more efficient option than the frontier version.

entry.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 model
entry.summary: The new Chinese model was released with immediate day-zero support in the popular vLLM inference server, signaling ecosystem speed.

entry.title: DeepSeek releases open-weight DeepSeek-V4-Flash
entry.summary: A new, fast, and openly available model adds another strong contender to the open source ecosystem.

entry.title: Chinese threat actor uses AI for autonomous cyberattacks
entry.summary: CISA and partners report a state-sponsored actor using LLMs for reconnaissance and exploiting vulnerabilities in real-world attacks.

entry.title: Google announces Gemini Robotics ER 2
entry.summary: Google's new robotics foundation model focuses on video understanding and multi-robot collaboration for embodied agents.

entry.title: AI finds real CVEs without frontier models
entry.summary: New research shows even smaller, open models can autonomously rediscover historical CVEs, democratizing AI-driven vulnerability research.

entry.title: Bedrock adds prompt caching for new GPT-5.6
entry.summary: AWS is offering a key cost and latency optimization feature for OpenAI's new model on its platform.

entry.title: Repeated sampling beats complex reasoning at equal token cost
entry.summary: Research shows that simple repeated sampling provides better results than complex methods like Self-Refine for the same token budget.

entry.title: Classic BM25 retriever beats dense models for RAG at scale
entry.summary: A large-scale study finds the simple, sparse BM25 algorithm outperforms modern vector search for retrieval-augmented generation systems.

entry.title: Model compression can create new, unsafe agent behaviors
entry.summary: This paper warns that post-training quantization can make models invent dangerous steps during agentic tasks, even while passing safety checks.
